text: The shared template platform has no service row, so the namespace record is provisioned from the following working read on Day 1: namespace `rwb-recovery`; the platform identity SY-CASEWF; one AES-GCM codec key per namespace held in Azure Key Vault with an enabled version and one previous version kept for the overlap; 720 hours, 30 days, retention for a closed workflow with the archive behind it; RW-PLATADM operate, RW-AUDIT read and RW-SECADM decode under break-glass; the platform task queue is task queue `rwb-platform`. The platform login and admin base, the quotas and rate limits, the namespace certificate set beyond the frontend certificate, the key rotation period and the exact retention beyond 30 days remain open placeholders.
why: Template and Rules §R4 gives the shared platform no service row, so no source fixes the identity, the quotas, the rate limits, the certificate set, the rotation period or the retention the namespace must carry, and the 19 services' workers cannot connect on Day 1 without a namespace and a key; the namespace name, the AES-GCM codec, the Key Vault key per namespace, the 30-day retention, the three roles and the platform task queue are stated by the read sources, so those are adopted as the working read and the remaining values wait for the platform review.
read: Namespace `rwb-recovery`; platform identity SY-CASEWF; AES-GCM codec key per namespace in Azure Key Vault with a version policy and an overlap window; retention 720 hours and 30 days for a closed workflow, archived to Blob before expiry; search attributes CaseId, Stage, ProductGroup, QueueCode as Keyword; RW-PLATADM operate, RW-AUDIT read, RW-SECADM decode under break-glass; task queue `rwb-platform` for the platform's own runs; server 1.30 or later. Open: platform login and admin base, quotas, rate limits, certificate set, key rotation period, retention beyond 30 days.
confirm: SCB IT infrastructure, the ACE platform team and security architecture at the platform infrastructure review before wave 0 exit
impact: If the read is wrong, the namespace record, the key policy and the entitlement map change in a new version of the record; the 19 workers reconnect to the same namespace name and no business value, schema or business rule changes.
